title: platanthera blephariglottis var. holopetala
intro: Platanthera blephariglottis var. holopetala, commonly known as the American Orchid or Yellow Fringed Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. The plant is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of P. blephariglottis var. holopetala are believed to include reducing fever, alleviating respiratory issues, and acting as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
